name: Square Teak Dining Table with Glass Top
description: Elegant square solid teak dining table with glass top, decorative wooden lattice and central Chinese tea set display. Ideal for 4-seater dining.
details: This square dining table is crafted from solid teak wood with a clear glass top and an attractive wooden lattice design. The centre features a decorative compartment designed to display a Chinese tea set. The natural teak finish and sturdy legs offer both style and durability. Perfect for Sri Lankan homes seeking a classic and functional dining table.
